Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct
an event called the Time Attack.\pIt is a race that measures how long
you take to reach our owner on\lthe rooftop from this counter.\pThe fastest times are posted on
the Time Board--try competing with\lyour friends.\pIn TRAINER battles along the way,
neither Exp. Points nor money will\lbe awarded.
Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have\nonly one POKéMON with you.\pYou will need at least two POKéMON\nto enter this event.

of the TRAINER HILL, because…\pYou want to form a tag team with me!

here marvelously quickly?\pHow splendid! You needn't have
